digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: 终端里的轻量级编码代理，用 Rust 打造，让 AI 直接在命令行完成编程任务

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 统一端点接入 290+ 模型商，90+ 免费源，兼容 Claude Code 等主流编码工具，零成本切换 AI 网关

repos.name: modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
repos.description: The official Python SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients
repos.summary_zh: 官方 Python SDK 让模型上下文协议落地，统一 AI 工具与数据交互标准，构建可互操作 Agent 生态

repos.name: alibaba/open-code-review
repos.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comme
repos.summary_zh: 阿里自用级代码审查工具，混合流水线与LLM Agent，精准行级评论加内置多语言规则集

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep
repos.description: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超快正则搜索工具，自动遵循 gitignore 规则，秒级检索海量代码库

repos.name: appwrite/appwrite
repos.description: Appwrite® - complete cloud infrastructure for your web, mobile and AI apps. Including Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Hosting, Realtim
repos.summary_zh: 开源后端云服务全家桶，一站式搞定认证、数据库、存储与函数，让Web和AI应用开发无需自建后端

repos.name: vuejs/core
repos.description: 🖖 Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building UI on the web.
repos.summary_zh: 渐进式前端框架，虚拟DOM与响应式系统兼备，组件化开发体验流畅，生态成熟且性能稳定

repos.name: moeru-ai/airi
repos.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's
repos.summary_zh: 自托管 AI 伴侣框架，支持实时语音与 Minecraft 联动，把 waifu 灵魂带入现实世界

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: lyogavin/airllm
repos.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
repos.summary_zh: 单张4GB显卡跑70B大模型推理，显存不够也能本地部署超大模型

repos.name: modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol
repos.description: Specification and documentation for the Model Context Protocol
repos.summary_zh: AI 与工具间标准上下文协议，让模型无缝调用外部数据与功能

repos.name: ai-dynamo/dynamo
repos.description: A Datacenter Scale Distributed Inference Serving Framework
repos.summary_zh: 数据中心级分布式推理框架，用 Rust 重写调度内核，专治大模型高并发部署的资源碎片化与延迟抖动

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片 MacBook 仅需 2GB 内存即可本地运行 Gemma 4 26B 模型，极致压缩显存占用

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型视觉感知评测基准，专测原子级细节识别能力，填补细粒度认知评估空白

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面神器，自托管替代TeamViewer，数据自主可控且跨平台流畅

repos.name: chatboxai/chatbox
repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台 AI 客户端，聚合主流大模型并支持本地数据存储，让对话记录完全私有

repos.name: atuinsh/atuin
repos.description: ✨ Making your shell magical
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 shell 历史记录，支持全文搜索、同步与加密，让命令行操作更高效安全

repos.name: cjpais/Handy
repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: 完全离线的免费开源语音转文字工具，用 Rust 打造，可扩展且隐私无忧

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: astral-sh/uv
repos.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 Python 包管理与项目工具链，速度提升数十倍且兼容现有生态

repos.name: sherlock-project/sherlock
repos.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
repos.summary_zh: 输入用户名即可跨平台检索其社交账号，开源免费且支持超400个网站

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: Rust 重写的 Bitwarden 服务器，自托管密码管理更轻量，资源占用远低于官方版

repos.name: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
repos.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的12周AI入门教程，24节实战课覆盖从神经网络到生成式AI全栈知识，零基础也能系统上手

papers.title: TokTier: Exact Stateful Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract: LLM serving systems cache prompt KV state, yet most front ends still re-tokenize the full request text on every call. The cost lands on coding agents, which resubmit a long transcript after each small
papers.summary_zh: 提出精确有状态分词机制，使代理式LLM服务复用缓存KV时免于全量重编码，长对话追加场景下分词边界稳定且开销降低逾九成

papers.title: GQ-FSL: Green Quantized Federated Split Learning
papers.abstract: Deploying state-of-the-art deep neural networks (DNNs) at the wireless edge is severely bottlenecked by the strict energy and resource constraints of mobile devices. While federated split learning (FS
papers.summary_zh: 提出绿色量化联邦拆分学习框架，结合动态量化与自适应剪枝，降低边缘设备能耗达百分之四十二，同时保持模型精度损失低于百分之一点五

papers.title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Imitation learning (IL)---training an agent to replicate expert behavior from demonstrations---underpins applications from robotics to language model training. Standard approaches such as Behavior Clo
papers.summary_zh: 提出价值型模仿学习的表征权衡理论，证明在线交互仅在特定条件下优于行为克隆，并给出误差界与样本复杂度分析

papers.title: ExtractBench: A Benchmark for Schema-Guided Enterprise Document Extraction
papers.abstract: Enterprise workflows increasingly rely on agents for \emph{schema-guided extraction}: given a document and a user-defined schema, the agent faithfully follows the schema to produce the correct output
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向企业文档的架构引导抽取基准ExtractBench，覆盖多领域复杂表格与嵌套字段，系统评测主流模型并揭示其证据溯源能力不足的短板

papers.title: Development of FDD-ON: an Ontology for VAV HVAC System Fault Detection and Diagnostics
papers.abstract: Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) technology is essential for improving HVAC system reliability, energy efficiency, and maintenance effectiveness. However, effective deployment of FDD solutions in b
papers.summary_zh: 构建VAV暖通空调故障检测与诊断本体FDD-ON，统一异构数据语义，实现跨系统知识共享与推理，为智能运维提供结构化支撑

papers.title: QASP: Query-Adaptive Robust Vector Search Policy
papers.abstract: A fundamental challenge of vector search is achieving consistently high recall while minimizing computational costs. Fixed search parameters cause significant performance variance across queries, and
papers.summary_zh: 提出查询自适应向量检索策略QASP，按查询动态调整搜索参数以稳定高召回率，消除平均指标掩盖的方差并降低计算开销

papers.title: AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers
papers.abstract: As LLMs evolve from code completion systems into autonomous scientific agents, evaluating their ability to conduct experiments has become increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically focus on
papers.summary_zh: 提出AgentHPOBench基准，评估LLM智能体作为顺序超参优化器的实验能力，填补动态决策评估空白，覆盖多任务并验证智能体优化性能

papers.title: Differentially Private Nonparametric Modal Learning with Applications to Regression and Clustering
papers.abstract: Density modes provide a localized and interpretable summary of multimodal distributions, but their estimation under rigorous differential privacy constraints remains largely unexplored. We study diffe
papers.summary_zh: 提出满足局部光滑假设的多元密度模态差分隐私估计框架，首次实现回归与聚类任务下模态恢复，隐私预算影响降至最优理论下界

papers.title: The Theoretical Foundation of Socratic Tests: Dynamic, Multimodal, Conversational Examinations
papers.abstract: Traditional static assessments rely on a subtractive, deficit-based grading model that often penalizes ambition and obscures diagnostic feedback. Conversely, traditional face-to-face oral examinations
papers.summary_zh: 提出苏格拉底式动态多模态对话考试框架，以增量评分替代扣分制，消除表演焦虑干扰，在诊断准确性与学生体验上显著优于传统静态评估

papers.title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models has shown strong promise for robotic manipulation. Among RL methods, critic-based approaches rely on a value estimator
papers.summary_zh: 提出世界评论家模型WCM，利用多帧观测与VLM潜变量融合提升价值估计精度，在机器人操作强化学习任务中显著优于单帧基线方法

papers.title: Sign compression for Muon: SignMuon, MuonSign, and the Limits of Error Feedback
papers.abstract: SignMuon compresses the Muon update to one bit per parameter by taking its elementwise sign, providing the most direct way to run a matrix-aware optimizer under an extremely low communication budget.
papers.summary_zh: 提出SignMuon将Muon更新压缩为每参数单比特符号，在极低通信预算下超越SignSGD，但发现其在线性函数上仍可上升，揭示误差反馈机制的局限

papers.title: Freeze, Then Select: Structured Field Adapters and Stability-Validated Weak Selection for PDE Discovery from Sparse Observations
papers.abstract: PDE discovery from sparse observations requires reconstructing a continuous field and selecting the correct differential terms. Our analysis of optimization paths in coupled neural PDE discovery revea
papers.summary_zh: 提出冻结后选择框架，结合结构化场适配器与稳定性验证弱选择，从稀疏观测中精准发现偏微分方程，有效区分持久与瞬态支持项

papers.title: Evolving language compositionality in a frequency-structured meaning space
papers.abstract: The iterated learning model was introduced to investigate language evolution: the way in which the characteristic properties of human languages have been shaped, at least partly, by repeated transmiss
papers.summary_zh: 迭代学习模型在频率结构语义空间中发现组合性涌现，证明语言演化受传输瓶颈驱动，且高频词更易形成规则映射
